blocks.h2: What a Mokena Plumbing Inspection Covers

steps.body: Age, venting, relief valve and sediment.
Valves that move and lines that aren't bulging.
Slow drains, leaks and running toilets.

blocks.intro: The village grew from about 1,600 people in 1970 to more than 18,000 by 2010. Thousands of homes got their plumbing at about the same time.

items.body: Water heaters, pumps and valves installed in the same year tend to fail in the same few years.
A failure downstairs is more expensive than it used to be.
Replacing a pump on a dry day costs less than replacing it in a storm.
A finished basement adds an ejector pump, extra drains and sometimes a wet bar. They're all part of the checkup.

blocks.h2: Plumbing Maintenance Questions From Mokena Homeowners

items.q: How often should I have a plumbing checkup?
items.answer: Once a year is a good rhythm, especially for homes with sump and ejector pumps.

items.q: What's the most common problem you find?
items.preview: Pumps and water heaters near the end.
items.answer: In Mokena homes, aging sump pumps, ejector pumps and water heaters are the most common findings.

items.q: Is a plumbing checkup part of the No Drip Club?
items.preview: Yes, the club includes maintenance visits.
items.answer: The [No Drip Club](/no-drip-club) includes regular maintenance visits. Ask us how it works.

items.q: Can you check my home before I sell it?
items.answer: Yes. A checkup before listing helps you fix small issues before the buyer's inspection finds them.

items.q: My house was built in 2005. Is a checkup worth it?
items.preview: Yes. Original equipment is past its usual life by now.
items.answer: Yes. A home from the mid-2000s is about 20 years old. Original water heaters and sump pumps are past their usual life, and shutoff valves start to wear out. A checkup tells you which ones.

items.q: What wears out first in a 1990s home?
items.answer: Usually water heaters, sump pumps and fixture parts like fill valves and cartridges.

items.q: How much does plumbing maintenance cost in Mokena?
items.preview: It depends on the visit. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on what's included. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
